items.description: Address and payment with the site navigation stripped and the order summary moved above the form on mobile — both aimed squarely at completion rate.

items.name: order-confirmation-page
items.title: Order Confirmed
items.description: The post-purchase screen, with navigation restored and a rail that shows what to buy next rather than what was just bought.

items.name: account-orders-page
items.title: Account Orders
items.description: Order history in the settings shell rather than a second sidebar layout — an account area and a settings area are the same shape.

items.name: signup-page
items.title: Signup Page
items.description: The signup form with the proof under it rather than above it — the person who arrived here has already decided, and scrolling past testimonials is friction applied to the wrong reader.

items.name: forgot-password-page
items.title: Forgot Password
items.description: Password reset, plus the magic link beside it — the moment after a password has failed is when somebody is most willing to stop using one.

items.name: two-factor-page
items.title: Two-Factor Challenge
items.description: The second factor with its fallback on the same screen, because a 2FA prompt with no recovery route is a lockout screen wearing a security screen.

items.name: sso-login-page
items.title: SSO Sign In
items.description: A domain field for the employee who signs in daily, and the capability detail below the fold for the IT reviewer who reads it once.

items.name: error-500-page
items.title: Server Error
items.description: Retry first, because a 500 is our failure and offering navigation implies the rest of the site works — which is exactly what is in doubt.

items.name: maintenance-page
items.title: Scheduled Maintenance
items.description: Planned downtime with an actual end time on it — "back soon" is not a time, and a maintenance page without one looks like an outage nobody has noticed.

items.name: permission-denied-page
items.title: Permission Denied
items.description: A 403 that names who can grant what was refused, because the next question is always "then who can" and a support link is the wrong answer to it.

items.name: usage-page
items.title: Usage & Limits
items.description: Consumption in the order the questions arrive: the overage warning first because it is time-critical, then the meters, then what actually happens at each limit.

items.name: invoices-page
items.title: Invoices
items.description: Billing history laid out for finance rather than for the user — a retrieval screen, so the table leads and the payment method comes last.

items.name: onboarding-page
items.title: Onboarding
items.description: A wizard for the session someone finishes and a checklist for the one they do not, with the only genuinely blocking step in front of both.

items.name: search-page
items.title: Search Results
items.description: Built around the state a search page is in most of the time — empty — so recent queries lead and the facets sit in a sidebar that survives growing to twelve.

items.name: agent-run-page
items.title: Agent Run Detail
items.description: One run opened up in the order you would debug it — intent, actions, the retries that are invisible in both, then cost.

items.name: approvals-page
items.title: Approvals Inbox
items.description: The queue, the same queue sorted by how long things have waited, and the policy that decided both — with the policy last so it is not scrolled past forever.

items.name: assistant-chat-page
items.title: Assistant Chat
items.description: The blank thread answered with real starter prompts, the model picker with the three numbers the choice turns on, and the four surfaces a session grows into — attachments, branches, canvas, threads.

items.name: agent-inspector-page
items.title: Agent Run Inspector
items.description: The three states an agent screen usually omits: the wait before the first token, the trace after something broke with retries costed in the open, and the diff it wants a person to accept.

items.name: retrieval-console-page
items.title: Retrieval Console
items.description: Why the answer said what it said: what is connected, how stale it is, what the query was allowed to see, what fitted in the window and what fell out — plus the failed-search state a debugging tool is most needed in.

items.name: ai-editor-page
items.title: AI Editor
items.description: Five ways to reach a model without the cursor leaving the sentence — slash menu, inline completion, selection toolbar, action menu, property inspector — and the two surfaces that say where the answer came from.

items.name: records-table-page
items.title: Records Table
items.description: A table after real people have used it — columns reordered from the keyboard, a selection bar that asks page-or-all, subtotals that survive collapsing, cells edited in place, and the empty state its own filters produced.

items.name: analytics-page
items.title: Analytics
items.description: The saved view and the comparison window first, because every figure below depends on both — then six charts, none of which load a charting library.

items.name: alerting-page
items.title: Alerting
items.description: Thresholds with how often each has actually fired, what that produced, where it went — and the digest settings that exist because of the answer.

items.name: notification-settings-page
items.title: Notification Settings
items.description: Notifications from the receiving end: the inbox you arrived from, per-event and per-channel control, and the push prompt asked after the decision rather than on arrival.

items.name: team-access-page
items.title: Team & Access
items.description: The admin screen a security questionnaire is really asking about — seats with the bill shown first, invitations, scopes split from bundles, sharing stated as its consequence, live sessions, and the audit trail underneath.

items.name: import-data-page
items.title: Import Data
items.description: The flow between an empty product and a useful one, in the order it goes wrong: sample data offered with equal weight, a file, a URL, the column mapping everything stalls on, and an upload that survives the connection dropping.

items.name: account-setup-page
items.title: Account Setup
items.description: A profile form where the role options state what they actually change, the avatar crop works from the keyboard, and a navigation guard names the fields it is about to throw away.

items.name: reset-password-page
items.title: Reset Password
items.description: The end of the forgot-password flow, shipped with the state it reaches more than any other screen: a focused error summary linking to each field, beside a strength meter that is a real <meter>.

items.name: app-shell-page
items.title: App Shell
items.description: The furniture that is on every screen and belongs to none — navbar, mobile drawer, command palette, shortcut sheet, header search, scope switcher, and the two shapes a detail view takes without losing the list.

items.name: security-landing-page
items.title: Security & Trust
items.description: The page a security questionnaire arrives from, written to be forwarded rather than to persuade: certifications early, benchmarks with a denominator, objections in a reviewer’s own words, and a route to a human.

items.name: migration-landing-page
items.title: Switching & Migration
items.description: The landing page for a reader whose current tool already works: the migration mechanism second rather than buried, integrations stated at depth, and deliberately no pricing section.

items.name: launch-note-page
items.title: Launch Note
items.description: A product announcement shaped as writing rather than a landing page — serif headline, real byline, three pieces of evidence, and an endpoint card that doubles as documentation for the week before the docs exist.

items.name: single-offer-page
items.title: Single Offer
items.description: One thing, one price, named above the fold — for a course, a consultation or a one-time licence, where there is nothing to compare against and hiding the number answers the only question last.

items.name: plan-change-page
items.title: Change Plan
items.description: Both directions, because only one of them is usually built: a radiogroup with the prorated charge announced as it changes, and a cancellation with the end date, what breaks, and one honest alternative offered once.

items.name: product-compare-page
items.title: Product Comparison
items.description: The page between a listing and a product detail, with the two questions a comparison table alone cannot answer: will it fit, and can I actually have it.

items.name: express-checkout-page
items.title: Express Checkout
items.description: Checkout for the buyer who will not fill in a form: wallet buttons above the fields, and the address a wallet returns shown and changeable before the charge rather than after it.

items.name: order-tracking-page
items.title: Order Tracking
items.description: For the customer with an order number and no account — a lookup, an arrival range rather than a promised date, and the review form where the "how did we do" email actually lands.

items.name: workspace-activity-page
items.title: Workspace Activity
items.description: Backwards from now and forwards from it on one screen — a day-grouped timeline, a month grid where a busy Tuesday never changes the row height, and the state both are in on day one.

items.name: first-run-page
items.title: First Run
items.description: What the product looks like while onboarding happens: a tour step anchored to the control it explains, the skeletons of the slowest load it will ever do, and the checklist that outlives both.

items.name: about-page
items.title: About Page
items.description: No hero — a reader who clicked "About" has already read the pitch and is checking whether the company is real, so the page opens with numbers and a timeline instead of a headline.

items.name: contact-page
items.title: Contact Page
items.description: The form first, then the four questions that cause most of the messages — answered here, because that is faster for the sender than a reply and leaves the inbox for what needs a person.

items.name: team-page
items.title: Team Page
items.description: Who we are, as distinct from who we are hiring: faces, the shape of the company in four numbers, and three working commitments that could actually be falsified.

items.name: faq-page
items.title: FAQ Page
items.description: Search and browse, in that order, because the two halves serve opposite visitors — one arrives from a search engine with a phrase, the other from the navbar with none.

items.name: case-study-page
items.title: Case Study
items.description: The numbers above the story, which is the opposite of how these are usually written: the colleague this link gets forwarded to needs the result in the first screen.

items.name: case-study-index-page
items.title: Case Study Index
items.description: Excerpts that lead with the outcome rather than the customer’s biography, filterable by industry — because the reader is scanning for a problem that resembles their own.

items.name: services-page
items.title: Services Page
items.description: For a business that sells work rather than licences: three engagements named by situation, and prices in a comparison table rather than a pricing card with a monthly toggle that does not apply.

items.name: integrations-index-page
items.title: Integrations Directory
items.description: Every connection with its real status on the card — live, beta or planned — because a directory that hides which is which is discovered at exactly the wrong moment.

items.name: integration-detail-page
items.title: Integration Detail
items.description: One connection, answering the four questions an integration page usually leaves to a support ticket: which records move, which way, how often, and what happens on conflict.

items.name: alternatives-page
items.title: Comparison / Alternatives
items.description: The competitor-name landing page, with a section naming where each rival is the better buy — which is what makes the other forty rows believable.

items.name: status-page
items.title: Status Page
items.description: Written for the person refreshing it during an outage: current state above the fold, the maintenance window as a real block with an end time, and a component list that names what still works.

items.name: roadmap-page
items.title: Public Roadmap
items.description: Board plus changelog, because a roadmap alone is a promise — the last three releases underneath are what turn the shipped column into something with dates attached.

items.name: webinar-page
items.title: Webinar / Event
items.description: Registration at the top and again at the bottom, with an agenda timed by the minute — so the reader knows what they are getting before handing over an address.

items.name: coming-soon-page
items.title: Coming Soon
items.description: The shortest page in the catalog, and it still says what the product does — including what it will not do at launch. No countdown, because a clock at zero is worse than no clock.

items.name: legal-page
items.title: Legal Document
items.description: Terms, privacy, DPA and cookies in one frame — the docs layout, because people arrive at a legal page looking for a specific clause and a wall of text makes that a Ctrl-F expedition.

items.name: community-page
items.title: Community Page
items.description: Member counts and reply times on every door, because "join our community" with no number reads as an invitation into an empty room — plus a digest for people who will not install another chat app.

items.name: affiliate-page
items.title: Affiliate Programme
items.description: Terms before the application, and a calculator so the reader sees a number rather than doing arithmetic with an ARPU they do not know.

items.name: testimonials-page
items.title: Testimonials Wall
items.description: Third-party scores first, because they are the only part of the page the company does not control — and the four-star quotes stay in, because a wall of nothing but fives reads as filtered.

items.name: gallery-page
items.title: Gallery / Showcase
items.description: A switcher rather than an infinite grid: four named views, one visible at a time, so the page weighs one image on load instead of forty.

items.name: portfolio-index-page
items.title: Portfolio Index
items.description: A studio’s list of work, with excerpts that name the outcome and the constraint rather than the aesthetic — a contents page, not a landing page.

items.name: about-page-02
items.title: About Page 02
items.description: The founder’s letter instead of the evidence wall: a byline and a dateline, for a company whose best asset is still conviction rather than a six-year record — and it ends on the job board, because /team is linked from job posts more often than from sales decks.

items.name: contact-page-02
items.title: Contact Page 02
items.description: Route before you write — three doors, each with the form its sender actually needs: a calendar for a buyer, a structured ticket for a broken import. One textarea costs a round trip.

items.name: team-page-02
items.title: Team Page 02
items.description: The team page that is really a recruiting page: it opens on the trade rather than the faces, and puts a salary band on every role — a board with three bands and one “competitive” teaches the reader which is the bad one.

items.name: faq-page-02
items.title: FAQ Page 02
items.description: Objection-ordered and search-free: the questions that lose deals first, hardest at the top, because a search box over eighteen questions implies a list long enough to get lost in — and its empty state reads as “no refund policy”.

items.name: case-study-page-02
items.title: Case Study 02
items.description: The narrative take, for a study found by search rather than forwarded by a champion: the customer’s sentence first, the numbers last, and the six weeks in the middle where the software was losing to a spreadsheet.

items.name: case-study-index-page-02
items.title: Case Study Index 02
items.description: A results directory rather than a reading list: search the situation, facet by entity count and ledger, and the aggregate claim sits at the bottom underneath the thirty-four rows it was computed from.

items.name: services-page-02
items.title: Services Page 02
items.description: One productised engagement with the price in the first screen and no mandatory call — a fixed price behind a scoping call is consulting with extra steps. Includes the paragraph naming when it is the wrong shape.

items.name: integrations-index-page-02
items.title: Integrations Index 02
items.description: Search-first, with facet counts including the zeroes — nobody browses an integration directory, and “Payroll (0)” answers the question inside the list the reader is already looking at.

items.name: integration-detail-page-02
items.title: Integration Detail 02
items.description: The setup guide, not the pitch: what moves and which way, then a five-step wizard — written for the person turning the connector on rather than the one deciding to buy it.

items.name: alternatives-page-02
items.title: Alternatives Page 02
items.description: One rival, head to head, for a reader who already owns the competitor — so the argument is what a migration costs, and the page opens by telling roughly a third of its readers to stay where they are.

items.name: status-page-02
items.title: Status Page 02
items.description: The status page read during diligence rather than during an outage: ninety days of uptime, the latency curve, and every incident carrying its post-mortem — including the bad one.

items.name: roadmap-page-02
items.title: Roadmap Page 02
items.description: Themes and refusals, no quarters — four problems stated as problems, plus the four things we have decided never to build, which is the section that takes nerve and the one customers actually need.

items.name: webinar-page-02
items.title: Webinar Page 02
items.description: The replay, ungated, for the traffic that arrives months after the event — the gate moves to the transcript and the template, where it is a trade rather than a toll.

items.name: coming-soon-page-02
items.title: Coming Soon 02
items.description: A referral queue with a real position: three places per invite, forty admitted a week, and the admission ceiling on the page rather than in the confirmation email — otherwise it is a dark pattern with a progress bar.

items.name: legal-page-02
items.title: Legal Document 02
items.description: One document with a plain-language column beside each clause, for the reader who cannot name the clause they need — and the cookie control inline, because a banner is unreachable the moment it has been dismissed.

items.name: community-page-02
items.title: Community Page 02
items.description: The calendar is the community: the next session bookable in the first screen, the month underneath, and the chat links demoted to a strip — an idle Slack is a worse first impression than a half-full calendar.

items.name: affiliate-page-02
items.title: Affiliate Page 02
items.description: Proof before arithmetic — what four named partners actually earned last quarter, including the one for whom it is not working, and no calculator anywhere. A slider shows what you could earn from numbers you picked yourself.

items.name: testimonials-page-02
items.title: Testimonials Wall 02
items.description: Segmented by who is talking rather than sorted by score, because a wall of forty quotes is uniformly impressive and uniformly irrelevant — with the full rating spread underneath, ones included.

items.name: gallery-page-02
items.title: Gallery Page 02
items.description: The whole catalogue at once, filterable, with the total stated up front — the opposite trade to the switcher, and it honestly costs ninety images on load rather than one.

items.name: portfolio-index-page-02
items.title: Portfolio Index 02
items.description: One project per screen, four in total, each naming the constraint it worked around — nobody reads four case studies, and the constraint is the only sentence a competitor cannot copy.

items.description: Stacked grade, overlay grain and a radial vignette, the grain stepped in three frames so it stutters like emulsion rather than sliding.

items.name: ocean-speed-dial-11103
items.title: Ocean Speed Dial
items.description: Floating action whose plus rotates into a cross while three satellites fan out along a quarter arc, each on its own translate.

items.name: ocean-icon-toolbar-11131
items.title: Ocean Icon Toolbar
items.description: Formatting cluster with a hairline separating groups, the alignment glyphs drawn from three background gradients rather than an icon font.

items.name: ocean-typing-indicator-11143
items.title: Ocean Typing Indicator
items.description: Chat bubble with a clipped tail and three dots bobbing on a rolling delay, resting for most of the cycle so it does not read as frantic.

items.name: ocean-build-log-11171
items.title: Ocean Build Log
items.description: Pipeline steps in monospace with completed ticks, one spinner on the running line, and pending steps dimmed rather than hidden.

items.name: ocean-event-card-11183
items.title: Ocean Event Card
items.description: Listing led by a tear-off date block in a real `<time>`, so the day and month are one semantic unit rather than two decorated spans.

items.name: ocean-notification-card-11211
items.title: Ocean Notification Card
items.description: Inbox rows where unread state is carried by a left rail, a faint tint and a dot at once, so it survives being skimmed at any zoom.

items.name: ocean-kinetic-letters-11223
items.title: Ocean Kinetic Letters
items.description: Characters riding one sine on a fixed phase offset, so the word ripples continuously instead of bouncing as a block.

items.name: ocean-redacted-text-11251
items.title: Ocean Redacted Text
items.description: Classified bars that wipe away from the right on hover, the words underneath present in the DOM the whole time so they stay selectable and searchable.

items.name: ocean-bokeh-field-11263
items.title: Ocean Bokeh Field
items.description: Out-of-focus orbs on one keyframe with negative delays, so the six start mid-cycle and the field is already in motion on first paint.

items.name: ocean-crt-static-11291
items.title: Ocean CRT Static
items.description: Phosphor tint under hard scanlines with a soft band rolling through, the three layers separate so each can be tuned without touching the others.

items.name: ocean-amount-field-11303
items.title: Ocean Amount Field
items.description: Currency input with a fixed symbol and a unit picker sharing the box, the figure in tabular numerals so the caret does not shift as digits change.

items.name: ocean-scoped-search-11331
items.title: Ocean Scoped Search
items.description: Search bar with a leading scope menu and a trailing key hint, all three sharing one focus ring so the control reads as a single field.

items.name: ocean-app-bar-11343
items.title: Ocean App Bar
items.description: Compact product header carrying mark, search, links and account in one blurred row, the search flexing so the ends stay pinned at any width.

items.name: ocean-wizard-header-11371
items.title: Ocean Wizard Header
items.description: Segmented flow header where each step's arrow is a rotated square inheriting its own background, so the notch always matches the segment behind it.

items.name: ocean-badged-divider-11383
items.title: Ocean Badged Divider
items.description: Section rule broken by a ringed medallion, the inner diamond rotated so the ornament reads as deliberate rather than as a dot.

items.name: ocean-slant-transition-11411
items.title: Ocean Slant Transition
items.description: Two bands with mirrored diagonal cuts meeting on one line, so the seam between sections is an angle rather than a horizontal rule.

items.name: ocean-level-badge-11423
items.title: Ocean Level Badge
items.description: Rank chip whose ring is a conic gradient showing progress to the next tier, with the raw figures underneath in tabular numerals.

items.name: ocean-category-pills-11451
items.title: Ocean Category Pills
items.description: Taxonomy links keyed by a colour dot rather than a filled background, so a row of them stays readable instead of turning into a paint chart.

items.name: ocean-glyph-switch-11463
items.title: Ocean Glyph Switch
items.description: Track carrying a tick and a cross drawn from borders, cross-faded so state is legible without relying on colour alone.

items.name: ocean-checkbox-list-11491
items.title: Ocean Checkbox List
items.description: Grouped options under a select-all whose indeterminate state is a bar rather than a tick, the one case a checkbox has three readings.

items.name: ocean-crosshair-readout-11503
items.title: Ocean Crosshair Readout
items.description: Chart hover state as one unit — dashed guide, marker dot and a value card pinned above the same x position, so the three never drift apart.

items.name: ocean-reaction-picker-11531
items.title: Ocean Reaction Picker
items.description: Tray that floats above its trigger on hover or focus, each option popping on an overshoot so the row feels physical rather than a menu.

items.name: ocean-gallery-skeleton-11543
items.title: Ocean Gallery Skeleton
items.description: Mixed-span grid placeholder, the wide cells breaking the rhythm so the loading state reads as a real masonry rather than a uniform block.

items.name: ocean-thread-skeleton-11571
items.title: Ocean Thread Skeleton
items.description: Comment placeholders with a nested reply indented behind a rule, so the shape of the conversation is visible before any text arrives.

items.name: ocean-unfold-expand-11583
items.title: Ocean Unfold Expand
items.description: Height animated with `grid-template-rows` from 0fr to 1fr — the one technique that transitions to intrinsic height without a hardcoded max-height.

items.name: ocean-blind-reveal-11611
items.title: Ocean Blind Reveal
items.description: Six slats collapsing on a stagger from their top edge, so the surface behind is uncovered in bands rather than by a single wipe.

items.name: ocean-underline-keyline-11623
items.title: Ocean Underline Keyline
items.description: Rule that draws left-to-right on enter and retracts to the right on leave, by flipping `transform-origin` between the two states.

items.name: ocean-inset-glow-ring-11651
items.title: Ocean Inset Glow Ring
items.description: Selection state built entirely from stacked box-shadows — hairline, inner bloom and outer halo — so nothing about the element's size changes.

items.name: ocean-thermometer-meter-11663
items.title: Ocean Thermometer Meter
items.description: Vertical gauge with a scale beside it, the column anchored to the bottom so it fills upward the way a reading actually behaves.

items.name: ocean-skill-bars-11691
items.title: Ocean Skill Bars
items.description: Labelled proficiency rows on a two-column grid so the name and the figure sit on one line with the track spanning both beneath.

items.name: ocean-action-overlay-11703
items.title: Ocean Action Overlay
items.description: Media tile whose controls rise into a dimmed frame on a stagger, using `transition-delay` so the sequence costs no keyframes.

items.name: ocean-image-collage-11731
items.title: Ocean Image Collage
items.description: Asymmetric three-up where the hero spans both rows, each tile lifting independently so the grid never reflows on hover.

items.name: ocean-corner-promo-11743
items.title: Ocean Corner Promo
items.description: Non-blocking announcement that slides up from the corner with its own dismiss, the pattern for news that does not deserve a modal.

items.name: ocean-loading-veil-11771
items.title: Ocean Loading Veil
items.description: Blocking overlay scoped to one panel rather than the page, blurring the content behind so it is clearly still there but not interactive.

items.name: ocean-success-toast-11783
items.title: Ocean Success Toast
items.description: Confirmation whose tick springs in from its own corner on an overshoot, so the mark lands rather than simply appearing.

items.name: ocean-connection-bar-11811
items.title: Ocean Connection Bar
items.description: Persistent network notice with a pinging indicator and a manual retry, sized as a bar rather than a toast because it does not auto-dismiss.

items.name: ocean-icon-accordion-11823
items.title: Ocean Icon Accordion
items.description: Separated disclosure cards where the icon brightens and the chevron flips on open, both keyed off `[open]` rather than a toggled class.

items.name: ocean-scrollable-tabs-11851
items.title: Ocean Scrollable Tabs
items.description: Overflowing tab strip with gradient masks at both ends, so a cut-off label reads as scrollable rather than as a rendering fault.

items.name: ocean-page-turn-11863
items.title: Ocean Page Turn
items.description: Leaf hinged on the spine and swept through 180 degrees, darkening as it passes edge-on so the sheet reads as having two sides.

items.name: ocean-spinning-pyramid-11891
items.title: Ocean Spinning Pyramid
items.description: Four CSS triangles hinged at a shared base and splayed by quarter turns, tilted so the solid closes rather than reading as loose fins.

items.name: ocean-ecg-trace-11903
items.title: Ocean ECG Trace
items.description: Heartbeat line cut from a clip-path polygon and scaled vertically, with a sweeping gain band passing over it like a monitor refresh.

items.name: ocean-halo-pill-11931
items.title: Ocean Halo Pill
items.description: Status chip sitting over a blurred copy of itself, the halo breathing on the same cycle as the dot so the two read as one pulse.

items.name: ocean-argyle-lattice-11943
items.title: Ocean Argyle Lattice
items.description: Offset diamond blocks crossed by two thin repeating diagonals, which is what separates argyle from a plain checkerboard on the bias.

items.name: ocean-terrazzo-11971
items.title: Ocean Terrazzo
items.description: Seven elliptical chips at irregular positions inside one tile, sized differently so the repeat is much harder to spot than a regular grid.

items.name: ocean-arch-window-11983
items.title: Ocean Arch Window
items.description: Rounded arch cut with asymmetric border-radius rather than a clip-path, so the inner keyline can follow the same curve at an inset.

items.name: ocean-diagonal-split-12011
items.title: Ocean Diagonal Split
items.description: Two panels cut on complementary diagonals with a deliberate gap between them, the labels nudged off-centre so neither straddles the seam.

items.name: ocean-candlestick-chart-12023
items.title: Ocean Candlestick Chart
items.description: OHLC bars where each candle's wick and body come from custom properties on the element, so the data lives in the markup and the CSS stays one rule.

items.name: ocean-donut-row-12051
items.title: Ocean Donut Row
items.description: Three small multiples sharing one scale, so utilisation across resources is comparable at a glance rather than three separate readings.

items.name: ocean-milestone-track-12063
items.title: Ocean Milestone Track
items.description: Roadmap where the current stage fills only half its connector, so "in progress" is visible on the rail rather than only in the node styling.

items.name: ocean-release-list-12091
items.title: Ocean Release List
items.description: Changelog entries with the version as a monospace tag, the latest highlighted so "what shipped most recently" is answerable without reading dates.

items.name: ocean-sparkline-table-12103
items.title: Ocean Sparkline Table
items.description: Trend column drawn inline per row, so direction and current value sit on the same line instead of in a chart somewhere else on the page.

items.name: ocean-empty-table-12131
items.title: Ocean Empty Table
items.description: Zero-row state that keeps the header so the columns still teach what will appear, with one action rather than a bare "no data" line.

items.name: ocean-multi-combobox-12143
items.title: Ocean Multi Combobox
items.description: Chips, a typeahead and an option list in one control, the menu opening on `:focus-within` so it survives tabbing into the field.

items.name: ocean-date-range-12171
items.title: Ocean Date Range
items.description: Two dates joined by an en-dash inside one focus ring, with quick presets underneath because most range picks are a common span, not an arbitrary one.

items.name: ocean-sticky-contents-12183
items.title: Ocean Sticky Contents
items.description: Document outline pinned beside scrolling body copy, the active entry marked by a coloured left rule so the position reads without a filled background.

items.name: ocean-reading-bar-12211
items.title: Ocean Reading Bar
items.description: Progress rail stuck to the top of its own scroller, scaled rather than resized so the indicator animates without triggering layout.

items.name: ocean-vertical-slider-12223
items.title: Ocean Vertical Slider
items.description: Level control filling upward with the handle anchored to the fill's top edge, so value and thumb cannot drift apart at any height.

items.name: ocean-auto-testimonials-12251
items.title: Ocean Auto Testimonials
items.description: Quotes cross-fading on a shared twelve-second cycle with progress bars filling in lockstep, so the indicator is the timer rather than a separate loop.

items.name: ocean-trophy-icon-12263
items.title: Ocean Trophy Icon
items.description: Cup, stem and plinth as three elements with the handles as mirrored pseudo-elements, so the whole award is drawn without an image.

items.name: ocean-security-shield-12291
items.title: Ocean Security Shield
items.description: Shield outline made by clipping a filled shape and an inset dark copy to the same polygon, with a padlock drawn from two children.

items.name: ocean-drag-handle-12303
items.title: Ocean Drag Handle
items.description: Sortable row whose dotted grip lights on hover and tilts fractionally while held, the cursor switching from grab to grabbing to confirm the state.

items.name: ocean-swipe-actions-12331
items.title: Ocean Swipe Actions
items.description: List row sliding aside to expose the actions parked behind it, the destructive option furthest out so it takes the longest travel to reach.

items.name: ocean-halftone-screen-12343
items.title: Ocean Halftone Screen
items.description: Repeating dot mask over a gradient, the cell size growing on hover so the screen coarsens the way a print separation would.

items.name: ocean-thermal-map-12371
items.title: Ocean Thermal Map
items.description: False-colour heat field from stacked radial gradients under an overlay scanline grid, with a monospace readout for the instrument look.

items.name: ocean-perspective-floor-12383
items.title: Ocean Perspective Floor
items.description: Ground plane laid flat under an 78-degree rotateX so the grid converges on a horizon, with the background position scrolling one cell per cycle to read as forward travel.

items.name: ocean-prism-drum-12411
items.title: Ocean Prism Drum
items.description: Four labelled faces mounted around a shared axis at a quarter turn each, the drum rotating one detent on hover so the next word rolls up into place.

items.name: ocean-facet-filters-12423
items.title: Ocean Facet Filters
items.description: Stacked filter groups on native details elements, each summary carrying its active count and each row its result tally so the panel reads before it is opened.

items.name: ocean-tab-overflow-12451
items.title: Ocean Tab Overflow
items.description: Tab strip that stops at the width it has and parks the remainder behind a counted overflow button, the popover anchored to its top-right corner.

items.name: ocean-detail-alert-12463
items.title: Ocean Detail Alert
items.description: Failure banner that keeps the stack trace folded behind a disclosure, so the summary stays one line and the detail is one click away rather than a separate screen.

items.name: ocean-permission-prompt-12491
items.title: Ocean Permission Prompt
items.description: Consent bar in the shape a browser uses for it — origin under the ask, block and allow weighted differently, the whole thing sized to sit under an address bar.

items.name: ocean-progressive-load-12503
items.title: Ocean Progressive Load
items.description: Blurred low-resolution stand-in sitting under the full image, the sharp layer fading over it and the status pill dropping out once there is nothing left to wait for.

items.name: ocean-upload-ring-12531
items.title: Ocean Upload Ring
items.description: Profile photo wrapped in a conic progress ring that fills as the upload lands, with a camera affordance notched out of the lower-right corner.

items.name: ocean-cellular-field-12543
items.title: Ocean Cellular Field
items.description: Six overlapping radial cells at fixed seed positions, each drifting on its own vector so the field reorganises without any single blob reading as the subject.

items.name: ocean-rain-streaks-12571
items.title: Ocean Rain Streaks
items.description: Three repeating-gradient sheets falling at different rates and densities, the parallax between them doing the work that individual raindrop elements would otherwise cost.

items.name: ocean-delta-chip-12583
items.title: Ocean Delta Chip
items.description: Percentage-change pill with a border-drawn caret, tabular figures so a column of them stays aligned, and a tinted fill derived from the same hue as the arrow.

items.name: ocean-priority-pennant-12611
items.title: Ocean Priority Pennant
items.description: Swallow-tail flag cut from a single clip-path, the notch shallowing on hover so the tag squares off as it is picked out of a list.

items.name: ocean-notched-legend-12623
items.title: Ocean Notched Legend
items.description: Fieldset-style frame where the label sits in a gap punched through the stroke, the notch made by matching the label background to the surface rather than by clipping.

items.name: ocean-segmented-ring-12651
items.title: Ocean Segmented Ring
items.description: Dashed arc border built from a conic gradient rather than dash properties, masked to a hairline so the segments can carry three colours and still rotate as one piece.

items.name: ocean-slide-to-unlock-12663
items.title: Ocean Slide to Unlock
items.description: Drag-track confirmation where the knob travels the full width and a tinted fill follows it, the prompt fading out once the gesture is past the point of being accidental.

items.name: ocean-download-progress-12691
items.title: Ocean Download Progress
items.description: One control carrying three states in sequence — label, determinate bar, then a checkmark — so the transfer never leaves the place the user clicked to start it.

items.name: ocean-progress-card-12703
items.title: Ocean Progress Card
items.description: Course-style tile that leads with how much is left rather than what it is, the meter animating to its real position once so a reduced-motion reader still sees 44 percent.

items.name: ocean-empty-state-card-12731
items.title: Ocean Empty State Card
items.description: Placeholder panel with a dashed edge that reads as a slot waiting to be filled, the plus glyph tilting on hover so the whole card behaves like one target.

items.name: ocean-radar-chart-12743
items.title: Ocean Radar Chart
items.description: Six-axis spider plot where the web is one repeating-radial and one conic gradient, and the series is a single clip-path polygon that scales up from the centre as it plots.

items.name: ocean-waterfall-chart-12771
items.title: Ocean Waterfall Chart
items.description: Bridge from one period total to the next, each floating bar offset by the running balance beneath it and connected by dashed leader lines so the arithmetic is visible.

items.name: ocean-zigzag-divider-12783
items.title: Ocean Zigzag Divider
items.description: Sawtooth rule cut with a repeating conic mask rather than drawn as triangles, so the tooth pitch is one background-size value and widens on hover.

items.name: ocean-ornament-divider-12811
items.title: Ocean Ornament Divider
items.description: Three lozenges at the centre of a pair of rules that taper into the surface, the middle one turning half a revolution on hover while the flankers hold still.

items.name: ocean-line-rise-12823
items.title: Ocean Line Rise
items.description: Each line pushed up out of its own overflow-hidden track on a short stagger, which reads as type setting itself rather than as three blocks sliding in.

items.name: ocean-counter-roll-12851
items.title: Ocean Counter Roll
items.description: Odometer entrance built from three digit columns behind fixed windows, each travelling a different distance and settling at a different moment so it lands like a mechanism.

items.name: ocean-posterize-bands-12863
items.title: Ocean Posterize Bands
items.description: Continuous gradient quantized into three tone steps by a multiplying repeating-gradient, the banding backing off on hover to show what was thrown away.

items.name: ocean-x-ray-sweep-12891
items.title: Ocean X-Ray Sweep
items.description: Inverting backdrop-filter revealed by an animated inset clip, with a lit scan edge riding the boundary so the wipe reads as an instrument passing over the plate.

items.name: ocean-card-number-field-12903
items.title: Ocean Card Number Field
items.description: Payment entry as one joined control — number above, expiry and CVC sharing the row below — with the detected brand mark sitting inside the field it applies to.

items.name: ocean-field-array-12931
items.title: Ocean Field Array
items.description: Repeatable row group where every entry carries its own remove control and the add affordance is dashed, marking it as the one row that is not yet data.

items.name: ocean-plasma-globe-12943
items.title: Ocean Plasma Globe
items.description: Filaments pinned to a pulsing core and swept through short arcs on mismatched cycles, each skewed as it travels so the discharge never looks like a rotating spoke.

items.name: ocean-bulb-marquee-12971
items.title: Ocean Bulb Marquee
items.description: Theatre sign whose bulbs are four repeat-axis radial gradients, stepped rather than eased so the chase clicks from lamp to lamp instead of sliding.

items.name: ocean-ringing-bell-12983
items.title: Ocean Ringing Bell
items.description: Bell drawn from one rounded block plus a crown and a lip, pivoting at the mount while the clapper runs a second, later-peaking keyframe so the two do not move as one body.

items.name: ocean-sync-arrows-13011
items.title: Ocean Sync Arrows
items.description: Two gapped arcs cut from one conic gradient with border-drawn heads at each opening, the whole glyph spinning on an ease that speeds through the middle of each turn.

items.name: ocean-mention-autocomplete-13023
items.title: Ocean Mention Autocomplete
items.description: Composer that switches to name-matching the moment an at-sign is typed, the partial token tinted in place and the handle right-aligned so the list scans as one column.

items.name: ocean-password-reveal-13051
items.title: Ocean Password Reveal
items.description: Masked field whose eye control drops its strike-through by scaling the bar to nothing from the centre, so the icon changes meaning without a second glyph swapping in.

items.name: ocean-infinity-loader-13063
items.title: Ocean Infinity Loader
items.description: Single dot traced around a lemniscate in eight keyframe stations, crossing at the waist so the two lobes read as one continuous circuit rather than two orbits.

items.name: ocean-folding-cube-13091
items.title: Ocean Folding Cube
items.description: Four quadrants hinged at the shared centre corner, each folding in on X and out on Y a beat after the last so the square appears to turn itself inside out.

items.name: ocean-squircle-frame-13103
items.title: Ocean Squircle Frame
items.description: Superellipse approximated with a 28-point clip-path, which holds its continuous curvature under scale in a way a border-radius corner visibly does not.

items.name: ocean-conic-sweep-mask-13131
items.title: Ocean Conic Sweep Mask
items.description: Radar-style wipe driven by an animated @property angle inside the mask itself, so the reveal follows a rotating wedge rather than a straight edge crossing the box.

items.name: ocean-add-to-cart-flight-13143
items.title: Ocean Add to Cart Flight
items.description: Ghost of the item arcing from the button to the basket and shrinking as it goes, the count bumping only once the flight lands so cause and effect stay in order.

items.name: ocean-task-strike-13171
items.title: Ocean Task Strike
items.description: Checkbox and label treated as one gesture — the tick springs in, the rule draws left to right, and the text dims last so the sequence reads as completion rather than deletion.

items.name: ocean-fullscreen-takeover-13183
items.title: Ocean Fullscreen Takeover
items.description: Dialog that grows from the footprint of the control that opened it to the whole viewport, its chrome fading in only after the box has finished travelling.

items.name: ocean-sheet-stack-13211
items.title: Ocean Sheet Stack
items.description: Three bottom sheets pushed one behind the other, each narrower and dimmer than the one in front, so depth in the navigation stack is legible without a back label.

items.name: ocean-locale-switcher-13223
items.title: Ocean Locale Switcher
items.description: Language menu listing each option in its own script rather than in the current one, with the ISO code trailing so the list stays scannable to someone who cannot read the endonym.

items.name: ocean-footer-sitemap-13251
items.title: Ocean Footer Sitemap
items.description: Three-column link map under a gradient border-image rule, each link underlining from its leading edge so the columns stay quiet until something is pointed at.

items.name: ocean-scale-fan-13263
items.title: Ocean Scale Fan
items.description: Interlocking arcs from two offset radial layers, the half-cell stagger doing the overlap that makes a scale pattern read as roofing rather than as rows of circles.

items.name: ocean-herringbone-13291
items.title: Ocean Herringbone
items.description: Two mirrored diagonal stripe fields butted at the centre line, which is the whole trick — herringbone is one hatch and its reflection sharing a seam.

items.name: ocean-countdown-ring-13303
items.title: Ocean Countdown Ring
items.description: Timer that empties rather than fills, the sweep animated through a registered angle property so the arc interpolates smoothly instead of snapping between conic stops.

items.name: ocean-signal-bars-13331
items.title: Ocean Signal Bars
items.description: Five-step strength meter that lights bottom-up on a stagger and leaves the tallest bar dark, which is what four-of-five actually looks like on a device.

items.name: ocean-scroll-sentinel-13343
items.title: Ocean Scroll Sentinel
items.description: List whose last child is a loading marker rather than a button, positioned so it enters the viewport a little before the content runs out and the next page can be fetched.

items.name: ocean-pull-to-refresh-13371
items.title: Ocean Pull to Refresh
items.description: Content sheet dragged down past its own top edge to expose a spinner parked behind it, the indicator scaling up from the gap rather than being pushed along by the sheet.

items.name: ocean-form-skeleton-13383
items.title: Ocean Form Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder shaped to the form it precedes — short label blocks over taller field blocks, a split row, and a submit bar carrying a warmer sweep than the fields above it.

items.name: ocean-kanban-skeleton-13411
items.title: Ocean Kanban Skeleton
items.description: Three-column board placeholder with uneven card heights and a per-column sweep delay, so the loading state carries the same ragged rhythm the real board will.

items.name: ocean-crossfade-slideshow-13423
items.title: Ocean Crossfade Slideshow
items.description: Slides stacked in place and dissolved between rather than translated, which keeps a full-bleed image from ever showing an edge, with the active dot stretching to a pill.

items.name: ocean-histogram-range-13451
items.title: Ocean Histogram Range
items.description: Two-handle range sitting under a distribution of the values it filters, bars inside the selection lit and the rest left grey so the user can see where the results actually are.

items.name: ocean-grouped-rows-13463
items.title: Ocean Grouped Rows
items.description: Collapsible group headers carrying their own subtotal, tinted across the row so a header never gets mistaken for data, with children indented under a disclosure caret.

items.name: ocean-inline-edit-grid-13491
items.title: Ocean Inline Edit Grid
items.description: Spreadsheet-style cells that outline under the pointer and drop into an editing state in place, so committing a value never costs a dialog or a round trip to a detail page.

items.name: ocean-variable-weight-13503
items.title: Ocean Variable Weight
items.description: Letters travelling from light to heavy on a per-character delay, picking up a vertical gradient as they thicken so the wave of weight is also a wave of colour.

items.name: ocean-scramble-decode-13531
items.title: Ocean Scramble Decode
items.description: Each slot holds a junk glyph and its real character stacked, swapping on a stepped keyframe left to right so the line resolves the way a cipher does rather than typing out.

items.name: ocean-commit-graph-13543
items.title: Ocean Commit Graph
items.description: Branch-and-merge history drawn with positioned gradient segments instead of SVG, so the fork stub, the parallel lane and the merge elbow are each one background layer.

items.name: ocean-day-agenda-13571
items.title: Ocean Day Agenda
items.description: Hour rail with events sitting in the slots they occupy and an empty hour left visibly empty, the current-time rule crossing the whole column with a dot on the gutter.

items.name: ocean-indeterminate-parent-13583
items.title: Ocean Indeterminate Parent
items.description: Parent control in the mixed state its children actually put it in — the tick collapsed to a dash rather than swapped for a different glyph — with the tally spelled out beside it.

items.name: ocean-power-button-13611
items.title: Ocean Power Button
items.description: IEC power glyph as the control itself, the broken ring and its stem lighting together and the housing picking up an ambient glow so the off state is unmistakably dead.

items.name: ocean-glossary-popover-13623
items.title: Ocean Glossary Popover
items.description: Dotted term in running text that opens a definition card rather than a one-line tip, with the headword repeated and a category line so it reads as an entry, not a hint.

items.name: ocean-calendar-popover-13651
items.title: Ocean Calendar Popover
items.description: Date field opening a month grid anchored beneath it, leading days from the previous month dimmed rather than blank so the week rows stay aligned to their columns.

items.name: ocean-book-cover-13663
items.title: Ocean Book Cover
items.description: Hardcover hinged at the spine rather than the page edge, so it swings past 90 degrees and lies back against itself the way a real cover does.

items.name: ocean-wireframe-globe-13691
items.title: Ocean Wireframe Globe
