items.name: slide-to-confirm-switch-15689
items.title: Slide To Confirm Switch
items.description: A deliberate confirmation control whose knob has to travel the full length of the track, dragging a green fill behind it while the shimmering prompt gives way to the completed label.

items.name: pull-chain-light-switch-15691
items.title: Pull Chain Light Switch
items.description: A ceiling lamp with a beaded pull chain that stretches downward when you take hold of it, lighting the bulb to amber and dropping a soft cone of light onto the floor below.

items.name: safety-cover-switch-15693
items.title: Safety Cover Switch
items.description: A hazard-striped guard hinged along its top edge that swings up and away before the lever underneath can throw, at which point the lever rides to the top of its slot and the status lamp goes green.

items.name: gear-mesh-toggle-15695
items.title: Gear Mesh Toggle
items.description: Two toothed wheels sitting idle in grey until the switch engages, when they take on cyan and turn against each other, the smaller one running faster as their teeth interlock.

items.name: sliding-tooltip-rail-15697
items.title: Sliding Tooltip Rail
items.description: Formatting toolbar served by a single tooltip pill that glides sideways to sit over whichever button the pointer reaches, swapping its label as it travels.

items.name: cascading-submenu-popover-15699
items.title: Cascading Submenu Popover
items.description: Context menu laid over a page whose chevroned row unfolds a second panel sideways, the flyout sliding out from under its parent as the pointer arrives.

items.name: overflow-tags-popover-15701
items.title: Overflow Tags Popover
items.description: Issue card whose label row ends in a plus-four counter; hovering the row lifts a popover that names the four labels which did not fit, each with its colour dot.

items.name: password-rules-popover-15703
items.title: Password Rules Popover
items.description: Sign-up form whose password field drops a rules popover over the field below it, showing a four-segment strength meter and ticking off the requirements already met.

items.name: iris-open-entrance-15705
items.title: Iris Open Entrance
items.description: Panel uncovered by a circular clip that widens from a point at its centre, a thin ring racing ahead of the opening before the heading and caption fade up inside.

items.name: quadrant-assemble-entrance-15707
items.title: Quadrant Assemble Entrance
items.description: Four coloured tiles spin in from the corners one after another and lock together into a two-by-two logo mark, after which the wordmark slides in beside it.

items.name: arc-toss-entrance-15709
items.title: Arc Toss Entrance
items.description: Card chip lobbed along a parabola — steady sideways travel crossed with a rise and fall — that drops into a dashed slot and lights its outline on landing.

items.name: skeleton-swap-entrance-15711
items.title: Skeleton Swap Entrance
items.description: Loading card whose shimmering grey placeholder bars dissolve on cue and are replaced by the real avatar, name and badge rising a few pixels into place.

items.name: compare-split-image-15713
items.title: Compare Split Image
items.description: Before-and-after frame split by a draggable-looking divider that travels right on hover, wiping the flat ungraded shot away to expose the colour-graded version underneath.

items.name: accordion-photo-strip-15715
items.title: Accordion Photo Strip
items.description: Five narrow photo slices where the hovered one expands to more than three times its share and lights up while the rest dim, its caption rising from the bottom edge.

items.name: crop-frame-image-15717
items.title: Crop Frame Image
items.description: Photo under a crop tool: corner handles and rule-of-thirds guides frame a square selection that stretches to a widescreen box on hover while the pixel readout swaps beneath it.

items.name: avatar-marquee-row-15719
items.title: Avatar Marquee Row
items.description: Band of member avatars that scrolls endlessly behind a soft fade at each edge, freezing under the pointer while every face grows and takes a blue rim.

items.name: cookie-consent-overlay-15721
items.title: Cookie Consent Overlay
items.description: Dimmed page with a consent bar pinned across its foot that grows upward on hover to unfold three category switches above the accept action.

items.name: stacked-toast-overlay-15723
items.title: Stacked Toast Overlay
items.description: Three notifications piled in the corner of a page with only their top edges showing, springing apart into a readable column while the pointer is over the page.

items.name: drop-zone-overlay-15725
items.title: Drop Zone Overlay
items.description: Attachment list that blurs behind a dashed upload veil when files are dragged over it, the veil scaling up around a bobbing arrow and its size limits.

items.name: screen-share-overlay-15727
items.title: Screen Share Overlay
items.description: Shared window ringed in pulsing green with a floating status pill that counts the elapsed time and widens on hover to reveal its microphone and camera toggles.

items.name: deploy-pipeline-toast-15729
items.title: Deploy Pipeline Toast
items.description: Toast that carries a three-stage pipeline along its foot, the connecting rail filling from left to right and each stage node lighting cyan as the deploy reaches it.

items.name: merge-conflict-alert-15731
items.title: Merge Conflict Alert
items.description: Version-control notice whose body is a two-line diff, the incoming and outgoing versions stacked in red and green and each side lighting up as you point at it.

items.name: rate-limit-alert-15733
items.title: Rate Limit Alert
items.description: Throttling notice showing the allowance as ten discrete tokens rather than a bar, each pip flashing bright as it drops back into the bucket one at a time.

items.name: card-declined-alert-15735
items.title: Card Declined Alert
items.description: Payment failure notice built around a miniature credit card with a stripe, chip and rejection badge, the card flinching every few seconds as if the reader pushed it back.

items.name: wizard-steps-accordion-15737
items.title: Wizard Steps Accordion
items.description: Setup accordion whose sections are numbered nodes threaded on a vertical rail, finished steps collapsing to a green tick and a summary while the current step stays open.

items.name: lifted-nav-tabs-15739
items.title: Lifted Nav Tabs
items.description: Bottom navigation bar where selecting a tab lifts its icon out of the bar on a springy curve into a glowing gradient disc and floats its label up underneath.

items.name: timeline-year-tabs-15741
items.title: Timeline Year Tabs
items.description: Tab strip drawn as a dated axis, with year ticks along a rail and a glowing marker that slides between them while the milestone below swaps in from the side.

items.name: ribbon-toolbar-tabs-15743
items.title: Ribbon Toolbar Tabs
items.description: Office-style ribbon where each tab swaps the strip below for a different captioned group of tool buttons, and every button lifts slightly as it is pointed at.

items.name: dna-helix-15745
items.title: DNA Helix
items.description: Stack of gradient rungs all turning about one vertical axis on a staggered offset, so the column reads as a double helix winding endlessly through the frame.

items.name: turntable-deck-15747
items.title: Turntable Deck
items.description: A record deck laid back into the picture plane, the platter raised above the plinth and turning under a tonearm that creeps slowly inward across the grooves.

items.name: voxel-wave-15749
items.title: Voxel Wave
items.description: A three by three field of isometric cubes, each built from a lit top and four shaded walls, riding up and down on a diagonal wave that crosses the grid.

items.name: gyroscope-rings-15751
items.title: Gyroscope Rings
items.description: Three nested gimbal rings each turning about a different axis at its own speed around a bright core, so the assembly never repeats the same silhouette twice.

items.name: fibre-patch-panel-15753
items.title: Fibre Patch Panel
items.description: Four dark fibre channels between lit ports, each carrying a bright packet of light from the source port to the far one, which flares white as the packet lands.

items.name: neon-dial-gauge-15755
items.title: Neon Dial Gauge
items.description: Round instrument face where the glow is a measurement: ticks light cyan up to the current reading, the boundary tick breathes, and a bright needle drifts either side of it.

items.name: neon-reflection-sign-15757
items.title: Neon Reflection Sign
items.description: A steady pink sign standing on a wet floor line, its blurred mirror image below wavering and skewing as if the puddle underneath it never quite settles.

items.name: neon-constellation-15759
items.title: Neon Constellation
items.description: Four nodes wired together by faint edges, with a bright signal running down each link in turn and every node flaring as the pulse arrives at it.

items.name: tartan-plaid-sett-15761
items.title: Tartan Plaid Sett
items.description: A woven tartan sett built from one asymmetric band group crossed over itself, so the navy blocks, pale checks and thin yellow over-check darken and brighten where they overlap.

items.name: wood-grain-board-15763
items.title: Wood Grain Board
items.description: A sawn timber board whose grain is drawn from three horizontal line periods that never line up, with a ringed knot swirling near the right edge.

items.name: corrugated-sheet-15765
items.title: Corrugated Sheet
items.description: A galvanised corrugated sheet where each ridge is shaded from trough to highlight and back, with a row of dark rivets pinned along the top and bottom edges.

items.name: quilted-padding-15767
items.title: Quilted Padding
items.description: Padded upholstery in which two crossing stitch lines cut the surface into diamonds and every diamond swells with its own highlight and shadow.

items.name: stamp-perforation-mask-15769
items.title: Stamp Perforation Mask
items.description: A postage stamp whose perforated border is punched by uniting a repeating grid of circular holes with a solid inner rectangle, so the bites land only on the four edges; it tilts and glows when picked up.

items.name: torchlight-reveal-mask-15771
items.title: Torchlight Reveal Mask
items.description: A word sunk almost invisibly into a dark panel, legible only inside a circular clip path that drifts back and forth across it like a torch beam.

items.name: venn-exclusion-mask-15773
items.title: Venn Exclusion Mask
items.description: Two overlapping discs composited with mask exclusion so the lens where they meet is punched clean out, leaving a pair of gradient crescents that swing and repaint on hover.

items.name: keyhole-peep-mask-15775
items.title: Keyhole Peep Mask
items.description: A gradient scene cut to an old-fashioned keyhole by uniting a circular mask with a narrow conic wedge below it, and the view pans across as you lean in on hover.

items.name: card-fan-carousel-15777
items.title: Card Fan Carousel
items.description: Five slides held like a hand of cards, pivoting about a point below the deck so they spread wide and brighten on hover while the middle card lifts clear.

items.name: story-progress-reel-15779
items.title: Story Progress Reel
items.description: A stories-style slide topped by five segment bars, two already spent and the third filling steadily across its track while the author strip and caption sit over the artwork.

items.name: mixer-fader-bank-15781
items.title: Mixer Fader Bank
items.description: Five channel faders in a console strip, each cap riding a lit groove against a tick scale, and the whole mix re-levels itself to a new set of positions on hover.

items.name: wheel-picker-reel-15783
items.title: Wheel Picker Reel
items.description: A drum of month labels standing on a 3D cylinder, fading as they curve away from the lit selection band, and rolling on by one notch when hovered.

items.name: heart-like-icon-15785
items.title: Heart Like Icon
items.description: A heart built from a rotated square and two discs that gives a double beat every few seconds and throws out an expanding like-ring when hovered.

items.name: padlock-unlock-icon-15787
items.title: Padlock Unlock Icon
items.description: A brass padlock whose shackle lifts and swings open about its right hinge on hover while the body turns green to confirm the unlock.

items.name: paper-plane-send-icon-15789
items.title: Paper Plane Send Icon
items.description: A two-tone paper dart clipped from a gradient, which darts up and to the right on hover while three speed dashes settle into place behind it.

items.name: hourglass-timer-icon-15791
items.title: Hourglass Timer Icon
items.description: A framed hourglass whose upper chamber empties through a thin stream into the heap below, and once the sand has run through the whole frame turns over to start again.

items.name: population-pyramid-chart-15793
items.title: Population Pyramid Chart
items.description: Age bands stacked around a centred label column, with one bar growing left and one growing right so the two populations can be compared band by band.

items.name: marimekko-mosaic-chart-15795
items.title: Marimekko Mosaic Chart
items.description: Mosaic of stacked columns where each column is as wide as the share of the market it represents, so both the split inside a region and the size of the region read from one block.

items.name: polar-rose-chart-15797
items.title: Polar Rose Chart
items.description: Eight equal-angle petals drawn from the centre, each reaching a different radius over faint guide rings so the values read as a rose rather than a row of bars.

items.name: pareto-combo-chart-15799
items.title: Pareto Combo Chart
items.description: Causes ranked as descending bars with a cumulative percentage line running across them and a dashed eighty percent rule marking where the vital few end.

items.name: waffle-pictogram-chart-15801
items.title: Waffle Pictogram Chart
items.description: Fifty squares in a ten-wide grid with thirty-four of them filled, so the proportion can be counted square by square instead of read off an axis.

items.name: venn-overlap-chart-15803
items.title: Venn Overlap Chart
items.description: Three translucent discs blended together so every intersection lightens, with the audience count printed in each exclusive region and in the shared centre.

items.name: flight-itinerary-steps-15805
items.title: Flight Itinerary Steps
items.description: Departure and arrival airports at either end of a dashed route, with a plane marker that flies the length of the path on hover and the flight details ruled off underneath.

items.name: locked-course-steps-15807
items.title: Locked Course Steps
items.description: Lesson chain running from a struck-through completed step through the in-progress one with its own part-filled bar, down to a padlocked step that is still out of reach.

items.name: sequence-diagram-steps-15809
items.title: Sequence Diagram Steps
items.description: Two dashed lifelines with request arrows crossing between them in order, a solid arrow out, a dashed reply back, and an activation bar marking how long the server was busy.

items.name: milestone-thermometer-15811
items.title: Milestone Thermometer
items.description: Fundraising tube filled from the bottom with milestone ticks scored across it and money labels beside each one, the reached amounts warmed and the level climbing toward the next milestone on hover.

items.name: handoff-swimlane-steps-15813
items.title: Handoff Swimlane Steps
items.description: Four steps dropped into two owner lanes, with diagonal connectors cutting between the lanes at every handoff so the work is seen changing hands twice.

items.name: history-scrub-steps-15815
items.title: History Scrub Steps
items.description: Version list running oldest to newest where pointing at an entry offers to restore it and strikes through every later edit, previewing exactly what rolling back would throw away.

items.name: spreadsheet-range-grid-15817
items.title: Spreadsheet Range Grid
items.description: Worksheet with a name box and formula bar over lettered columns and numbered rows, one column selected as a single outlined range complete with a fill handle at its corner.

items.name: skeleton-loading-table-15819
items.title: Skeleton Loading Table
items.description: Real column headers over rounded grey placeholder bars of uneven length, a highlight sweeping across them on a stagger and speeding up while the pointer is over the table.

items.name: row-reorder-table-15821
items.title: Row Reorder Table
items.description: Stage rows carrying dotted grip handles, where pointing at one lifts it off the table with a shadow and drops a blue insertion line beneath it.

items.name: row-action-reveal-table-15823
items.title: Row Action Reveal Table
items.description: File rows whose size column slides away on hover as a strip of edit, download and delete buttons glides in from the right edge to take its place.

items.name: directory-avatar-table-15825
items.title: Directory Avatar Table
items.description: Member list whose first column packs an initials disc beside a name stacked over its email address, with the role carried as a pill on the right and the owner pill tinted.

items.name: import-error-grid-15827
items.title: Import Error Grid
items.description: CSV import preview headed by a red count banner, the two offending cells tinted and underlined with a wavy rule that raises the reason for the rejection on hover.

items.name: star-rating-field-15829
items.title: Star Rating Field
items.description: Five-star input showing a saved rating of four, where sweeping across it clears the stored fill and repaints the row up to whichever star sits under the pointer.

items.name: slug-preview-field-15831
items.title: Slug Preview Field
items.description: Title field with the published address mirrored underneath it, the slugged half highlighted inside a dashed strip and a copy button sliding over the end on hover.

items.name: form-completion-meter-15833
items.title: Form Completion Meter
items.description: Profile checklist headed by a conic progress ring reading sixty percent, with the finished requirement ticked and greyed and each outstanding one offering an add button on hover.

items.name: error-summary-panel-15835
items.title: Error Summary Panel
items.description: Red summary block counting the form errors above the fields themselves, where hovering one of the listed messages rings the field it belongs to and reddens its label.

items.name: autosave-draft-field-15837
items.title: Autosave Draft Field
items.description: Draft editor with a blinking caret and a green saved stamp in its header that swaps for a spinning saving indicator the moment the field is touched.

items.name: scroll-to-accept-terms-15839
items.title: Scroll To Accept Terms
items.description: Licence text scrolling inside a fixed frame that fades out at its bottom edge, above a dimmed accept row whose disabled button explains on hover that the text must be read to the end.

items.name: quantity-odometer-stepper-15841
items.title: Quantity Odometer Stepper
items.description: Quantity stepper whose figure lives on a vertical strip, so pointing at plus or minus rolls the next number up into the window like an odometer wheel before you have even clicked.

items.name: segment-thumb-preview-15843
items.title: Segment Thumb Preview
items.description: Segmented range control whose blue thumb slides under whichever label you point at, previewing the choice on an overshoot curve and settling back on the checked segment when the cursor leaves.

items.name: hold-to-confirm-ring-15845
items.title: Hold To Confirm Ring
items.description: Destructive button guarded by a hold: the red conic ring around the bin sweeps from empty to full over the second and a half you keep the pointer down, and drains back if you let go early.

items.name: menu-bars-morph-15847
items.title: Menu Bars Morph
items.description: Menu button whose three stacked bars converge and rotate into a cross as the middle bar squeezes out of existence, the caption swapping from Menu to Close on the same beat.

items.name: day-night-switch-15849
items.title: Day Night Switch
items.description: Theme toggle where the amber sun travels across the track, cools to pale grey and has a bite taken out of it by an offset disc so it lands as a crescent moon over a sky that has meanwhile filled with stars.

items.name: sort-header-caret-15851
items.title: Sort Header Caret
items.description: Table header row where pointing at a column raises a half-lit caret to show it can be sorted, the live column keeping a solid caret and a blue underline, and pressing flips the caret end over end.

items.name: ambient-glow-bleed-15853
items.title: Ambient Glow Bleed
items.description: Now-playing card that lights itself: a second copy of the artwork sits behind the first under a heavy blur and a saturation boost, so the sleeve bleeds its own colour onto the card, spreading further on hover.

items.name: color-dodge-foil-tilt-15855
items.title: Color Dodge Foil Tilt
items.description: Collector card finished in holographic foil: blurred rainbow stripes composited in color-dodge over the dark stock with a hard-light sheen above them, both sliding the other way as the card is hovered so the foil appears to tilt.

items.name: plus-lighter-crossfade-15857
items.title: Plus Lighter Crossfade
items.description: Two artwork plates dissolve back and forth in plus-lighter blending, so instead of the usual muddy dip in the middle the overlap adds light and the halfway frame is the brightest one; hovering pauses the dissolve wherever it stands.

items.name: peer-desaturate-strip-15859
items.title: Peer Desaturate Strip
items.description: Filmstrip of colour cards where touching any one of them drains the colour out of every other card and dims it, while the card under the cursor gains saturation and contrast and steps forward.

items.name: insert-gap-divider-15861
items.title: Insert Gap Divider
items.description: The hairline sitting in the gap between two blocks turns into a working control when you reach for it: the rule goes blue and dashed, a plus button springs up at its left end and an Insert block label slides out from behind it.

items.name: split-pane-grip-15863
items.title: Split Pane Grip
items.description: The separator holding an editor and its preview apart is a working splitter: reaching for the nine-pixel channel lights it blue, stretches its three grip dots and pushes a pair of arrowheads out into each pane to say which way it drags.

items.name: column-rule-divider-15865
items.title: Column Rule Divider
items.description: A separator that is not an element at all: text flowing through a two-column layout is split by its own column-rule down the gutter, pinned at the middle by a small diamond node that turns and lights up with the rule on hover.

items.name: branch-merge-divider-15867
items.title: Branch Merge Divider
items.description: Section separator drawn as a merge in a commit graph: two coloured branch lines drop from their labelled tips, curve inward through rounded elbows and join at a pulsing node before continuing as a single grey trunk below.

items.name: overflow-tag-group-15869
items.title: Overflow Tag Group
items.description: Truncated tag list where the +3 counter is not just a count: hovering the group collapses the counter to nothing and unrolls the three hidden tags out of the same space one after another, each widening from zero.

items.name: chevron-path-tags-15871
items.title: Chevron Path Tags
items.description: Location tags cut with a chevron point on one end and a matching notch on the other so they interlock into a single path strip, and pointing at any segment lights it and every segment leading up to it in blue.

items.name: filter-chip-set-15873
items.title: Filter Chip Set
items.description: Set of chips that carry their own state: a checked chip flips to solid sky and slides a tick out from its left edge, and the moment any chip in the set is checked a Clear link widens into being at the end of the row.

items.name: grade-scale-badge-15875
items.title: Grade Scale Badge
items.description: Rating badge that shows the whole A-to-E scale rather than a single letter: the four grades this item did not earn stay short and desaturated while the awarded grade grows tall, keeps its full colour and takes a marker above it.

items.name: toast-stack-skeleton-15877
items.title: Toast Stack Skeleton
items.description: Notification stack placeholder with two dimmed toasts peeking out behind the front card, whose icon, title and body bars carry the sweep; hovering fans the pile apart.

items.name: mail-client-skeleton-15879
items.title: Mail Client Skeleton
items.description: Three-pane inbox placeholder — an icon rail, a message list with one row already marked as selected, and a reading pane with a sender block and ragged body lines — under one sweep across all three panes.

items.name: product-detail-skeleton-15881
items.title: Product Detail Skeleton
items.description: Product page placeholder holding its real shape — hero image over a thumbnail strip on the left, title lines, a rating row, a green price block, size chips and a full-width buy bar on the right.

items.name: typewriter-fill-skeleton-15883
items.title: Typewriter Fill Skeleton
items.description: Text placeholder that writes itself in rather than shimmering — each bar grows from zero width behind a blue caret that hands off to the line below, so the card fills top to bottom like typed copy.

items.name: hazard-tape-border-15885
items.title: Hazard Tape Border
items.description: Warning panel edged with a twelve-pixel band of diagonal caution stripes that crawl continuously around the box, the dark plate inset inside it carrying a faint amber keyline.

items.name: dog-eared-frame-15887
items.title: Dog-Eared Frame
items.description: Outlined note whose bottom-right corner is folded back, the flap painting over the frame so the diagonal becomes the new hairline edge, and peeling further open on hover.

items.name: punched-ledger-frame-15889
items.title: Punched Ledger Frame
items.description: Panel framed as a page torn from a binder — three punched holes cut down the left edge from one stacked box-shadow, a red margin rule beside them and faint horizontal rules across the plate, sliding free of the rings on hover.

items.name: callout-tail-frame-15891
items.title: Callout Tail Frame
items.description: Tooltip outline whose pointer is a rotated square carrying two of the four border sides, its fill blanking the panel stroke behind it so the hairline runs unbroken into the tail — which slides the length of the edge on hover.

items.name: hourglass-timer-meter-15893
items.title: Hourglass Timer Meter
items.description: Remaining time read as sand rather than a bar — the level in the top cone drops while the heap in the bottom one builds, with a dashed grain stream falling through the waist and the whole glass turning over on hover.

items.name: odometer-counter-meter-15895
items.title: Odometer Counter Meter
items.description: Running total shown on a mechanical counter — five digit wheels behind a shaded bezel, the four higher ones holding their reading while the red units wheel turns continuously through a strip that ends on a duplicate zero so the loop never jumps.

items.name: waffle-grid-meter-15897
items.title: Waffle Grid Meter
items.description: Percentage drawn as a hundred-cell waffle, one square per point, sixty-eight of them lit in a blue-to-indigo run that stops part way through a row; hovering lights the next seven in a paler tint to preview the charge.

items.name: variance-meter-15899
items.title: Variance Meter
items.description: Signed deviation read from a centre zero rather than from the left edge — the amber fill runs right of the line for over-plan and a green one runs left for under, with a dashed target marker and a readout that swaps sign as the value crosses on hover.

items.name: frozen-grid-corner-15901
items.title: Frozen Grid Corner
items.description: Data grid frozen on both axes at once — the header row sticks to the top, the metric column sticks to the left, and the corner cell carries both offsets with a higher stacking order so it never slips under either.

items.name: sticky-card-pile-15903
items.title: Sticky Card Pile
items.description: Steps that clamp to four staggered bottom offsets, so at rest they sit piled at the foot of the scroller with twenty pixels of each showing and peel away one by one as the list scrolls past them.

items.name: parallax-depth-scroller-15905
items.title: Parallax Depth Scroller
items.description: Three ridge layers and a sun pinned behind the copy, each one driven by the scroller’s own scroll timeline at a different rate, so the near ridge travels five times further than the far one as the article moves over them.

items.name: scroll-spine-timeline-15907
items.title: Scroll Spine Timeline
items.description: Delivery tracker whose spine fills from the scroller’s own scroll timeline while each milestone dot lights on its own view timeline as it crosses the dashed read line pinned across the pane.
